model.title: About the Machine Learning Engine
model.subtitle: Transparent AI benchmarks, preprocessing methods, and model evaluation
model.pipelineStep1: 1. Normalization & Typo Resolution: Cleaned 10+ spelling variations across Area, Build Type, Sale Condition, Utilities, and Streets.
model.pipelineStep2: 2. Data Leakage Prevention: Completely eliminated REG_FEE and COMMIS to avoid target leakage.
model.pipelineStep3: 3. Feature Engineering: Extracted Building Age (Sale Year - Build Year) and standardized quality ratings.
model.pipelineStep4: 4. Target Log Transformation: Log1p transformation applied to stabilize target variance, evaluated back on INR currency scale.
